skill.name: outreachgenie-list-audit
skill.description: Audit saved OutreachGenie prospect lists and flows for missing template values, product text limits, and incomplete collection using read-only snapshots.
skill.summary: Check saved list coverage and outreach templates locally without modifying records or sending messages.
skill.author: outreachgenie

content.user_title: Audit OutreachGenie Lists and Flow Templates
content.value_statement: Saved prospect lists can contain missing template values, incomplete captures, and text that exceeds product limits. This skill checks selected snapshots locally and produces private reports without modifying records or sending messages.
actual_capabilities: Validate snapshot structure, selected identifiers, captured read-tool results, and the supported builtin-field catalog.
Check selected-list pagination, membership totals, missing pages, and duplicate prospect records for internal coverage.
Identify malformed template tokens, missing list-level custom-field metadata, empty saved values, and uncaptured or unsupported values.
Check raw invitation and message lengths, plus rendered lengths for supported invitation, message, sequence, and comment fields.
Generate JSON and Markdown reports without raw contact values or message bodies, using private POSIX permissions and refusing existing output directories.
Run an offline fictional demonstration and bundled behavioral tests without an account or network connection.
limitations: Snapshot limits include 5 MiB, 20 selected lists, 1,000 captured calls, 1,000 memberships, 200 nodes, 500 text fields, and 10,000 findings.
Checks cannot authenticate snapshots or prove live state, graph reachability, scheduling, reply state, delivery, contact permission, or policy compliance.
Connected use requires authorized OutreachGenie access, an MCP-capable host, and local Python 3.10+; named-host and OAuth integrations remain unvalidated.
Snapshots contain personal data; reports retain sensitive identifiers and field names, and non-POSIX permission behavior remains unverified.

use_cases.title: Review Saved Outreach Templates
use_cases.description: Find empty personalization values and product text-limit failures before separately deciding whether to prepare a campaign.

use_cases.title: Verify Selected List Evidence
use_cases.description: Check pagination completeness, duplicate memberships, and list-specific field metadata in an authorized capture.

use_cases.title: Evaluate the Offline Audit
use_cases.description: Run the fictional fixture and behavioral tests before planning a connected MCP integration.

prompt_templates.title: Run the Fictional Demo
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the bundled fictional snapshot audit in a new private directory. Summarize membership coverage and template findings without exposing saved values.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner evaluation without an OutreachGenie account.

prompt_templates.title: Audit an Existing Snapshot
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the snapshot at [private snapshot path] into [new private output directory]. Separate empty values, unknown evidence, text-limit failures, and coverage issues.
prompt_templates.scenario: Review an existing authorized local capture.

prompt_templates.title: Collect a Selected Workspace
prompt_templates.prompt: Verify workspace [workspace ID]. Capture flow [flow ID] and lists [list IDs] using documented read tools. Preserve scope and pagination. Run the local audit. Report any incomplete collection without changing records.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate connected audit with explicit identifiers.

prompt_templates.title: Compare List-Specific Evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [private snapshot path] for flow [flow ID] across selected lists [list IDs]. Compare list metadata with referenced custom fields. Distinguish unknown values from known blanks. Explain duplicate memberships, unchecked actions, and coverage limits. Propose separate follow-up tasks without changing data or activating campaigns.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review across multiple selected lists.

output_examples.input: Run the bundled fictional snapshot audit.
output: Coverage: all selected memberships captured; three unique prospects across four list memberships.
Text fields checked: four. Findings include missing list metadata, empty required rendered text, and a rendered invitation above its limit.
One invitation measures 232 UTF-16 units against a limit of 200.
Unchecked action: reply check. These results do not authorize campaign activation or sending.

output_examples.input: Review a snapshot with a missing selected-list page and a referenced custom-field container that was not captured.
output: Coverage is incomplete because a selected-list page is missing.
The referenced custom value is unknown, not a confirmed blank.
Capture the missing evidence before drawing completeness or rendered-text conclusions.
No records were modified and no messages were sent.

best_practices: Confirm workspace, flow, and list identifiers; capture unfiltered pages in order and label partial evidence explicitly.
Use authorized read access, prefer OAuth limited to crm.read, and keep snapshots and reports outside public or synced repositories.
Review unknowns and unchecked actions separately; treat corrections and campaign decisions as separately authorized tasks.
anti_patterns: Treating zero findings or a successful exit code as campaign readiness, contact permission, deliverability, or policy compliance.
Inventing missing values, merging unrelated captures, removing duplicate evidence silently, or choosing ambiguous lists without confirmation.
Pasting credentials into chat, publishing customer snapshots, or claiming connected collection has no third-party processing.

faq.question: Does this skill send messages or change records?
faq.answer: No. It uses captured read results and writes local reports. It does not activate campaigns, enrich prospects, or perform LinkedIn actions.

faq.question: Can I try it without an OutreachGenie account?
faq.answer: Yes. The bundled fictional fixture and offline tests need only local Python 3.10 or newer.

faq.question: What is required for a connected audit?
faq.answer: You need authorized workspace access, saved lists and a flow, an MCP-capable host, private local storage, and Python 3.10 or newer.

faq.question: Does connected collection stay entirely offline?
faq.answer: No. The local helper makes no network calls, but connected collection shares returned records with the MCP service and chosen AI host.

faq.question: What do complete coverage and zero findings mean?
faq.answer: They describe only the supplied snapshot and implemented checks. They do not prove live completeness, contact permission, delivery, or readiness to send.

faq.question: Are Claude, Codex, and Claude Code integrations verified?
faq.answer: No. The package uses the Agent Skills format, but real account connections and named-host invocation remain unvalidated. Local Python execution is required.
